a1cd5703b5.h: تحالف سياسي جديد في إسرائيل يضم حزبي آيزنكوت و«الديمقراطيون»
p: أعلن حزب «الديمقراطيون» اليساري وحزب «يشار» الذي يتزعمه غادي آيزنكوت، يوم الخميس، عن إبرام اتفاق سياسي مشترك يهدف لتأسيس الائتلاف الحكومي القادم في إسرائيل.
وتأتي هذه الخطوة لتدعم موقف آيزنكوت وتحالفه السياسي، غير أن الأغلبية المطلوبة لتولي الحكم لم تكتمل بعد لصالح هذا التجمع الجديد.

46538bafc3.h: Egypt and Qatar Urge Gaza Ceasefire and Closer Economic Ties
p: During a meeting in Cairo on Thursday, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani emphasized the urgency for all involved sides to adhere to the Gaza Strip ceasefire accord. The Egyptian presidency reported that the leaders also highlighted the necessity of securing humanitarian relief delivery and initiating early recovery and reconstruction efforts promptly.
Furthermore, the discussions between the two leaders focused on regional de-escalation alongside the enhancement of bilateral cooperation in the economic and energy sectors.

373ca5ec53.h: Coalition Spokesman Blames Houthi Militia for Jazan Refinery Assault
p: RIYADH: Houthi forces targeted the petroleum facility in Jazan, a military official announced. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who speaks for the coalition backing the legitimate government in Yemen, confirmed the hostile action through official channels.
A strong military retaliation will face any attempts to strike non-combatants and civilian infrastructure, the spokesman warned in a statement published by the Saudi Press Agency.

9c217f470f.h: ناجون يروون أهوال انفجار شاحنة الوقود في الجيزة
p: نقل شهود عيان تفاصيل مرعبة عما عاشوه، خلال حادث انفجار شاحنة وقود وقع على الطريق الدائري بنطاق محافظة الجيزة في مصر.
وأعرب هؤلاء الشهود عن صدمتهم البالغة إزاء المشاهد المروعة التي لحقت بالمكان جراء احتراق الشاحنة المحملة بالمواد البترولية.

5407c12769.h: Saudi Deputy Foreign Minister Updates Ambassadors on Houthi Assaults
p: Dr. Saud Al-Sati, the deputy minister for political affairs at the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, hosted diplomatic envoys stationed in the Kingdom for a series of briefings. The gatherings took place at the ministry headquarters in Riyadh during Wednesday and Thursday.

During these sessions, the ambassadors received detailed updates regarding Houthi assaults directed at Saudi Arabia. The meetings also included Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesman for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.

d16b65efbb.h: Army Was Aware of Explosive Hazards at Iowa Facility Over a Year Ago
p: New evidence indicates that the military branch was cognizant of instability concerns regarding explosives at an Iowa facility significantly earlier than previously understood. Initiatives aimed at eliminating these hazardous materials commenced over twelve months ago.
However, the disposal process was left unfinished during that initial period. This delay ultimately created the conditions that led to the controversial explosion on Wednesday.
